_readme: Golden cases pin the engine to a known-good output. Two `source` styles:
- 'in-game (pending)' / a measurement note: fill `expected` from an actual
game measurement (pip-boy damage card or hit numbers vs a known
target); `expected: null` cases are skipped until measured.
-> computeScenarios output for an archetype build, captured to lock the
assembly seam (OMOD collection order, weapon-stat drop, damage-type
materialization, SPECIAL fold order) against regression — it proves
stability, not correctness. tolerancePct is tight (0.01) since it's
exact recomputation, not a fuzzy in-game reading.
- 'hand-computed': `expected` is derived independently by spec math, a
correctness anchor distinct from both of the above.
scenario: freeAim | vats. Sneak and weakpoint targeting are player
conditions/enemyConditions patch the defaults from src/types/index.ts.
